answer: Persistent Work Thread. Each identity must carry a continuous, publicly replayable history of accepted micro-tasks; new identities start with zero and can only earn reputation by completing tasks that pay slowly. Any task assignment checks this thread before dispatch. Cloning a sparrow-level identity gains nothing, since a fresh clone forfeits all accumulated standing and must redo weeks of low-value work. A raven-tier attacker cloning N identities pays N times the full onboarding labor cost, making mass fakery strictly more expensive than operating one honest identity.
